full_judgment:
(e) "transfer" means transfer by private sale, settlement, lease, sub-letting, gift, mortgage or any contract or agreement but does not include a complete usufructuary mortgage or a mortgage to a Land Mortgage Bank registered or deemed to be registered under the Bengal Co-operative Societies Act, 1940, or registered under the Co-operative Societies Act, 1912[.] 

 "It was brought to the notice of Government that in some areas the land-holders were selling out or otherwise transferring all kinds of lands including waste lands in their khas possession on a large scale with a view to get a greater benefit out of the provisions of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Bill 1948, when enacted and put into operation. It was apprehended that if such transfers were allowed to go on unrestricted, the land-holders would dispose of their excess khas lands leaving little land to be acquired by Government under the proposed State Purchase Scheme, for distribution among agriculturists having no land or possessing uneconomic holdings. It was, therefore, considered necessary that immediate steps should be taken to restrict such transfers of khas lands on a large scale." 

 "This fact amply proved that long before the East Bengal Transfer of Agricultural Land Act 1951 came into being, plaintiff No.1 asserting his right as an auction purchaser possessed the disputed land. This being the position plaintiff No. 1 was not required to make any purchase from plaintiff No. 2. I, therefore, hold that the deed of release Ext. 7 was not a deed of transfer, it was a simple deed acknowledging the claim of plaintiff No. 1. In view of the facts, I hold that the impugned order passed under the Provisions of the East Bangal Transfer of Agricultural Land Act, 1951 (Act XXXIII of 1951) was illegal, void and not binding upon the plaintiffs". 

 "transfer" means transfer by private sale, settlement, lease, sub-letting, gift, mortgage or any complete usufructuary mortgage or a mortgage to a Land Mortgage Bank registered or deemed to be registered under the Bengal Co-operative Societies Act, 1940, or registered under the Co-operative Societies Act, 1912."
